edit.description: GateContext gains stateRootRel per spec/chain.md 'What a gate receives'; update flumeDir doc comment to state it is the primary checkout's root, never rebased, at both gate points.

Compute stateRootRel (relative(repoRoot, flumeDir), absent when it climbs out or is absolute) at all three gate.run call sites (~1844, ~2378, ~3130); share the computation with harvestFriction's existing stateRootRel (~3255) rather than re-deriving it, per engineering.md 'The fix lands at the mechanism'.

pendingGate reads the gated commit via join(ctx.stateRootRel, pendingPath) when stateRootRel is set, falling back to the existing disk read only when it is absent (relocated state root) — replaces the relative(ctx.repoRoot, join(ctx.flumeDir, pendingPath)) computation that assumes flumeDir nests under repoRoot.

Pin stateRootRel's value on a dispatcher-built afterCommit GateContext where flumeDir is an ancestor of the worktree repoRoot (the real afterCommit shape), and the absent case when the state root is relocated outside repoRoot.

Regression per engineering.md 'A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote': build the GateContext the way runAfterCommitGates does (flumeDir ancestor of repoRoot, not nested under it) and assert pendingGate reads the gated commit's tracked pending.json via stateRootRel — the shape the PENDING-GATE-STALE-TIP-READ fix shipped dormant against.

summary: Wire GateContext.stateRootRel so pendingGate reads the gated commit's tracked pending.json instead of falling back to a stale disk read
tests: stateRootRel is set to the repo-relative offset when flumeDir is inside repoRoot, absent when relocated outside it

pendingGate resolves the gated commit's pending.json via stateRootRel when flumeDir is the primary checkout's root and repoRoot is a worktree nested under it (real afterCommit shape, not the inverted fixture the shipped test used)
acceptance: GateContext.stateRootRel is computed once by the dispatcher and shared with harvestFriction; pendingGate uses it to read the gated sha's tracked pending.json in a real afterCommit worktree layout, activating the fix PENDING-GATE-STALE-TIP-READ shipped dormant
notes: Open question 'GateContext.flumeDir isn't rebased...' answered option B, engine-computed offset, ratified into spec/chain.md by 6120a2ef. Question stays open until this ships (its own text: 'Question closes when it ships').
